**Juan Hernández Guizar** is an aerospace systems engineer at [Blue Origin](https://www.blueorigin.com/), where he leads digital twin and model-based systems engineering initiatives for advanced space programs. His work combines systems modeling and digital transformation with a commitment to technical excellence, inclusive leadership, and community-building.

**UC Merced** | Merced, CA  
B.S. in Mechanical Engineering (May 2018)
